why: Issue #630. Locked rows lose their padlock. A screen reader still hears 'Locked.', but on screen the only difference between an earned and a locked achievement is `opacity: 0.45` against 1 plus a gold border, a dimming and a hue that forced colours and a greyscale screenshot both flatten. The empty slot survives, so a check for `.hud-achievement-icon` alone would pass; the case looks for the svg inside it.
killedBy: HUD achievement list (issue #629) marks a locked achievement with a padlock, not only a dimming and a border hue (issue #630)
